    AgentFlow workflows

    • workflows.list List AgentFlow workflows
    • workflows.get Get an AgentFlow workflow and its brief

    workflows.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows MCP workflows_list

    List AgentFlow workflows

    Workflows: ordered steps, each handled by an agent, started by hand, on a schedule or by an event. Filters: status, agent (id or name: workflows with a step it runs), project and q.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    statusenumOne of draft, active, paused.
    agentstringAgent id or name.
    projectstringProject id or name.
    qstring
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "draft",
        "active",
        "paused"
      ]
    },
    "agent": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Agent id or name."
    },
    "project": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Project id or name."
    },
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    {
  "items": [

      ],
      "projects": [
        "p1"
      ],
      "cards": [],
      "items": [],
      "created": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "updated": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}

    workflows.get read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows/{workflow} MCP workflows_get

    Get an AgentFlow workflow and its brief

    One workflow by id or name, with brief: Markdown listing its trigger, its steps with the agent for each, and its linked projects, cards and deadlines.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    workflowstringrequiredWorkflow id or name.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "workflow": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Workflow id or name."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "workflow"
  ],

}

    workflows.create write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows MCP workflows_create

    Create an AgentFlow workflow

    Add a workflow. Each step names an agent (id or name, or "" for unassigned), what it does and what it produces. Links (projects, cards, items) are ids or names.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    namestringrequired
    descriptionstring
    statusenumOne of draft, active, paused.
    triggerenummanual, schedule or event. One of manual, schedule, event.
    schedulestringWhen or on what it starts, e.g. "Weekdays at 09:00".
    stepsobject[]
    steps[].idstring
    steps[].agentstringAgent id or name; "" for unassigned.
    steps[].actionstring
    steps[].outputstring
    projectsstring[]
    cardsstring | integer[]
    itemsstring[]
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 120
    },
    "description": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 4000
    },
    "status": {
      "enum": [
        "draft",
        "active",
        "paused"
      ]
    },
    "trigger": {
      "enum": [
        "manual",
        "schedule",
        "event"
      ],
      "description": "manual, schedule or event."
    },
    "schedule": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "When or on what it starts, e.g. \"Weekdays at 09:00\"."
    },
    "steps": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 100,
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 80
          },
          "agent": {
            "type": "string",
            "minLength": 0,
            "maxLength": 200,
            "description": "Agent id or name; \"\" for unassigned."
          },
          "action": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 500
          },
          "output": {
            "type": "string",
            "maxLength": 300
          }
        },
        "required": [],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "projects": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 100,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 200,
        "description": "Project id or name."
      }
    },
    "cards": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 100,
      "items": {
        "type": [
          "string",
          "integer"
        ],
        "description": "Card number (\"12\", \"#12\") or id."
      }
    },
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "maxItems": 100,
      "items": {
        "type": "string",
        "minLength": 1,
        "maxLength": 200,
        "description": "Timeline item id or title."
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "name"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    workflows.update write

    PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/workflows/{workflow} MCP workflows_update

    Update an AgentFlow workflow

    Change a workflow's fields. steps you send replace the old ones (keep a step's id to keep it); so do projects, cards and items.

    Input

    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    workflowstringrequiredWorkflow id or name.

    steps[].idstring
